description: Revealing and glazing an existing coal shoot, replacement of internal doors and a new door to the garden, built-in wardrobe with a door to the bedroom, restoration of bathroom floorboards, replacement of the existing rear roof dormer with a solar thermal heat panel above and the installation of one rear roof window and a flue outlet and heat exchanger unit on the roof
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: 00_090 Rev A, 00_220 Rev A, 00_230 Rev D, 00_300 Rev A, 00_320 Rev A, 00_330 Rev A, 00_340 Rev A,  01_090 Rev A, 01_300 Rev A,  01_320, 01_330 Rev A, 01_340 Rev A, 21_010, 32_015, 32_010, 32_016, Design & Access & Heritage Statement received 18 September 2023; 00_010 received 4 October 2023

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
